definitions.explanation: The final stage of work or the quality of how something is completed. Refers to both the act of finishing and the result.

examples.japanese: {仕上|しあ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕上|しあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I drizzled chocolate on the cake as a finishing touch.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仕上|しあ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The finish on this furniture is beautiful, and you can feel the craftsman's skill.

notes:
{仕上|しあ}げ is the noun form of {仕上|しあ}げる (to finish, to complete). It means both the act of finishing and the quality of the finished result.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕上|しあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the finishing stage
- {仕上|しあ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{綺麗|きれい}: nicely finished
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕上|しあ}げ: the final touches
- {仕上|しあ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: the finishing stage
- {仕上|しあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do ~ as a finishing touch

DOMAINS:
Used across many fields — cooking ({仕上|しあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦パセリ→パセリ：21585_paseri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧), crafts, woodworking, painting, writing, and any work process with a final polishing stage.

RELATED WORDS:
- {仕上|しあ}げる: to finish, to complete (verb)
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧: to be finished, to turn out (intransitive)
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧: the finished result, how something turned out
